g.text: The DEAP run can share parent trials across partitions; DREAMER window fractions vary with trial duration

g.text: Initialize rule centers with K-means on up to 30,000 standardized training rows; initial Gaussian width = 1

g.text: Each dataset has its own scaler; each target has separate trainable rule and consequent parameters

g.text: D = 70; C = 2; R = 32 for DEAP / 16 for the DREAMER example

g.text: Fuzzy antecedents: Gaussian memberships

g.text: z[b,r,d] = 0.5 × ((x[b,d] - c[r,d]) / sigma[r,d])²

g.text: Distance tensor [B,R,70]

g.text: Centers + raw widths: DEAP 4,480 / DREAMER 2,240 parameters

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Linear consequents: one predictor per rule

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Weights W [R,70,2]; biases b [R,2]

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: g[b,r,c] = dot(x[b,:], W[r,:,c]) + b[r,c]

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Every rule produces a low and a high class score

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Rule logits g [B,R,2]; no per-rule class softmax

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Weights + biases: DEAP 4,544 / DREAMER 2,272 parameters

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: HTSK score: mean over 70 features

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: q[b,r] = -mean(z[b,r,:]) → [B,R]

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: A higher score means a closer match to that rule's pattern

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Compute directly in log space

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Rule softmax: normalize across R rules

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: alpha = softmax(q, axis=rules) → [B,R]

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Rule strengths sum to 1; several rules can match a window

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Membership counts: DEAP 2,240 / DREAMER 1,120

g.text: Supervised training of both branches

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Training labels → sparse categorical cross-entropy

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Backpropagation + Adam update c, s, W and b

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Learning rate 0.01; batch size 256; 100 epochs; seed 42

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Select each target's lowest-validation-loss checkpoint

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Validation / test rows do not update model parameters

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: DEAP selected epochs: valence 40; arousal 29

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Combine the weighted rule logits

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: logits[b,c] = sum_r(alpha[b,r] × g[b,r,c]) → [B,2]

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: A nonlinear mixture of R input-dependent linear predictors

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Class softmax: normalize across 2 classes

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: p = softmax(logits, axis=classes) → [P(low), P(high)]

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: argmax gives the window's predicted class

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: Run the model separately for valence and arousal on each dataset

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #16324f

g.text: DEAP: 32 rules → 9,024 trainable parameters per target; DREAMER example: 16 rules → 4,512 per target

g.text: The unified drawing describes a reusable architecture. Datasets, splits, fitted scalers and trained weights remain separate; no joint model was evaluated.
